step_by_step_approach: Collect monthly sales figures for each product starting from January 2016.
Compute a centered moving average of sales for each product.
Calculate the seasonality‑adjusted sales ratio by dividing actual sales by the moving average for each month.
Select the ratios that correspond to the months of the year 2017.
Check each product to see if its ratio is greater than 2 for every month in 2017.
Return the list of products that satisfy this condition.
